children: Malaysia's central bank and Japan's finance ministry have signed a cooperation agreement to promote settlement of trade and investment in local currencies, according to a joint statement on Tuesday.
"Both authorities have reached mutual agreement on initiatives relating to the promotion of the use of local currencies in eligible cross-border transactions," it said.
